title: GUNS GO ON KEYS 1 TO 4
why: His order of 2026-10-13: lets redo the bar at the bottom, so the player can only carry 4 guns max. Build 2 of 8. A gun belongs on the four gun keys. Dragging a gun onto any other key (the raid belt, the Undercroft belt, or the plan row on the Stash screen) is now refused with GUNS GO ON KEYS 1 TO 4 and nothing moves; a gun still goes onto keys 1 to 4 as before. An old saved belt plan loses the gun bindings it had on keys 5 to 9, once (the guns themselves are untouched and the rest of the plan stays where it is), and a plan stamped with the new version is no longer slid down again by the older migration.
now: Guns now go only on keys 1 to 4; a gun dragged onto any other key is refused.
